# 00. SETUP

```{r}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Statistics
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(metafor)
library(quadprog)

# Options
options(scipen = 999, width = 120)
set.seed(1234)
```

# 01. DATA CLEANING

```{r}
################################################################################
# 01. DATA CLEANING
################################################################################

raw_file <- "03_mup_raw.xlsx"

# ESP2013 weights (validated against CSO MORT02, see DECISIONS.md)
esp_2013 <- tibble(
  age_group = c("Under 1 year", "1 - 4 years", "5 - 9 years", "10 - 14 years",
                "15 - 19 years", "20 - 24 years", "25 - 29 years", "30 - 34 years",
                "35 - 39 years", "40 - 44 years", "45 - 49 years", "50 - 54 years",
                "55 - 59 years", "60 - 64 years", "65 - 69 years", "70 - 74 years",
                "75 - 79 years", "80 - 84 years", "85 years and over"),
  esp_weight = c(1000, 4000, 5500, 5500, 5500, 6000, 6000, 6500, 7000, 7000,
                 7000, 7000, 6500, 6000, 5500, 5000, 4000, 2500, 2500)
)
print(sum(esp_2013$esp_weight))

# ESP2013 collapsed to NRS broad cancer age bands
esp_2013_broad <- tibble(
  age_group = c("Under 25", "25 to 34", "35 to 44", "45 to 54", "55 to 64",
                "65 to 74", "75 to 84", "85 to 89", "90 and over"),
  esp_weight = c(27500, 12500, 14000, 14000, 12500, 10500, 6500, 1500, 1000)
)
print(sum(esp_2013_broad$esp_weight))

# UK nations, alcohol-specific ASMR (ONS 2024 release)
ons_nation <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ons_nation") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = area, outcome = "alcohol_specific", source = "ONS") %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, sex, outcome, deaths, rate = asmr, source)
print(count(ons_nation, jurisdiction))

# English regions, alcohol-specific ASMR
ons_region <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ons_region") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = paste0("Eng: ", area), outcome = "alcohol_specific", source = "ONS") %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, sex, outcome, deaths, rate = asmr, source)
print(count(ons_region, jurisdiction))

# North East + North West combined (ratio of sums; standardised population proxy = deaths / ASMR)
ons_ne_nw <- ons_region %>%
  filter(jurisdiction %in% c("Eng: North East", "Eng: North West")) %>%
  mutate(std_pop = deaths / rate) %>%
  group_by(year, sex) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deaths), rate = sum(deaths) / sum(std_pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Eng: NE+NW", outcome = "alcohol_specific", source = "ONS (derived)")
print(head(ons_ne_nw))

# Scotland 2025 from NRS (same ONS/NRS definition)
nrs_annual <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "nrs_annual") %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Scotland", outcome = "alcohol_specific", source = "NRS 2025",
         rate = as.numeric(asmr)) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, sex, outcome, deaths, rate, source)
print(nrs_annual)

# Ireland deaths by 3-character ICD-10 and age (CSO VSA35 2007-2018, VSA29 2019-2024)
cso_deaths <- bind_rows(
  read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_vsa35"),
  read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_vsa29")
) %>%
  mutate(deaths = replace_na(deaths, 0)) %>%
  filter(age_group != "All ages")
print(count(cso_deaths, source_table, year) %>% head(20))

# Ireland population (CSO PEA01, thousands -> persons)
cso_pop <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_population") %>%
  mutate(population = population * 1000)

# Ireland outcome groups (ICD-10, 3-character)
ie_alcohol <- cso_deaths %>%
  filter(icd10 %in% c("F10", "K70", "X45", "X65", "Y15")) %>%
  mutate(outcome = "alcohol_specific")
ie_k70 <- cso_deaths %>%
  filter(icd10 == "K70") %>%
  mutate(outcome = "k70")
ie_cancer_nonalc <- cso_deaths %>%
  filter(str_detect(icd10, "^C\\d\\d$"),
         !icd10 %in% c(sprintf("C%02d", 0:15), sprintf("C%02d", 18:22), "C32", "C50")) %>%
  mutate(outcome = "cancer_non_alcohol")
ie_cancer_all <- cso_deaths %>%
  filter(icd10 == "80005") %>%
  mutate(outcome = "cancer_all")
ie_oesophagus <- cso_deaths %>%
  filter(icd10 == "C15") %>%
  mutate(outcome = "oesophageal_cancer")

# Ireland ASMR (ESP2013) by sex
ireland <- bind_rows(ie_alcohol, ie_k70, ie_cancer_nonalc, ie_cancer_all, ie_oesophagus) %>%
  group_by(outcome, year, sex, age_group) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(cso_pop, by = c("year", "sex", "age_group")) %>%
  inner_join(esp_2013, by = "age_group") %>%
  group_by(outcome, year, sex) %>%
  summarise(rate = sum(deaths / population * 1e5 * esp_weight) / sum(esp_weight),
            deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Ireland", source = "CSO (computed)",
         sex = recode(sex, "Both sexes" = "Persons", "Male" = "Males", "Female" = "Females"))
print(filter(ireland, outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons"), n = 30)

# Validation: computed Irish cancer ASMR vs CSO published MORT02
ie_check <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_mort02") %>%
  filter(cause == "Malignant neoplasms", statistic == "Age-standardised mortality rate") %>%
  mutate(sex = recode(sex, "Both sexes" = "Persons", "Male" = "Males", "Female" = "Females")) %>%
  inner_join(filter(ireland, outcome == "cancer_all"), by = c("year", "sex")) %>%
  mutate(ratio = rate / value)
print(summary(ie_check$ratio))

# England cancer and oesophageal cancer DSR (Fingertips 93959, 94004)
england_cancer <- bind_rows(
  read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ft_cancer") %>% mutate(outcome = "cancer_all"),
  read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ft_oesophageal") %>% mutate(outcome = "oesophageal_cancer")
) %>%
  filter(is.na(`Category Type`), str_detect(`Time period`, "^\\d{4}$")) %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "England", year = as.numeric(`Time period`),
         sex = recode(Sex, "Male" = "Males", "Female" = "Females"),
         source = "Fingertips") %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, sex, outcome, deaths = Count, rate = Value, source)
print(count(england_cancer, outcome, sex))

# Scotland cancer ASMR from NRS broad age-specific rates (ESP2013 collapsed), by sex
scotland_cancer <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "nrs_cancer_age") %>%
  inner_join(esp_2013_broad, by = "age_group") %>%
  group_by(icd10, year, sex) %>%
  summarise(rate = sum(rate * esp_weight) / sum(esp_weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Scotland", deaths = NA_real_, source = "NRS (computed)",
         outcome = recode(icd10, "C00-C97" = "cancer_all", "C15" = "oesophageal_cancer")) %>%
  select(-icd10)
print(filter(scotland_cancer, outcome == "cancer_all", year >= 2015))

# Persons for cancer = mean of male and female ASMR (same rule for both nations)
cancer_persons <- bind_rows(
  scotland_cancer,
  filter(england_cancer, sex != "Persons")
) %>%
  group_by(jurisdiction, year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sex = "Persons (mean of sexes)", deaths = NA_real_, source = "derived")

# Harmonised annual panel
panel <- bind_rows(ons_nation, ons_region, ons_ne_nw, nrs_annual, ireland,
                   england_cancer, scotland_cancer, cancer_persons) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rate), rate > 0) %>%
  arrange(jurisdiction, outcome, sex, year)
print(count(panel, jurisdiction, outcome), n = 50)

# Scotland monthly ASMR (NRS Table 7)
scotland_monthly <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "nrs_monthly") %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01"), format = "%Y %B %d"),
         rate = as.numeric(asmr)) %>%
  select(date, year, month, deaths, rate)
print(range(scotland_monthly$date))

# Deprivation: Scotland SIMD quintiles (NRS) and England IMD deciles -> quintiles (Fingertips)
scotland_simd <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "nrs_simd") %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons") %>%
  mutate(nation = "Scotland", rate = as.numeric(asmr)) %>%
  select(nation, year, quintile, rate, deaths)
england_imd <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ft_mortality_imd") %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Category Type`, "4/23"), Sex == "Persons") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(`Time period`),
         quintile = case_when(
           Category %in% c("Most deprived decile (IMD2019)", "Second most deprived decile (IMD2019)") ~ 1,
           Category %in% c("Third more deprived decile (IMD2019)", "Fourth more deprived decile (IMD2019)") ~ 2,
           Category %in% c("Fifth more deprived decile (IMD2019)", "Fifth less deprived decile (IMD2019)") ~ 3,
           Category %in% c("Fourth less deprived decile (IMD2019)", "Third less deprived decile (IMD2019)") ~ 4,
           Category %in% c("Second least deprived decile (IMD2019)", "Least deprived decile (IMD2019)") ~ 5,
           TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(year, quintile) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(Value), deaths = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(nation = "England")
deprivation <- bind_rows(scotland_simd, england_imd)
print(count(deprivation, nation, quintile))

# Admissions: Scotland ARHS (SMR01 EASR stays), England Fingertips 92906, Ireland HIPE (crude)
admissions_scotland <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "phs_arhs") %>%
  filter(SMRType == "SMR01") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_sub(FinancialYear, 1, 4)), jurisdiction = "Scotland") %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate = EASRStays, count = NumberOfStays)
admissions_england <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "ft_admissions") %>%
  filter(`Area Name` == "England", Sex == "Persons", is.na(`Category Type`)) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_sub(`Time period`, 1, 4)), jurisdiction = "England") %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate = Value, count = Count)
admissions_ireland <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_asd09_hipe") %>%
  filter(str_detect(statistic, "^Number of discharges"), group == "Both sexes") %>%
  inner_join(filter(cso_pop, sex == "Both sexes", age_group == "All ages") %>% select(year, population),
             by = "year") %>%
  mutate(jurisdiction = "Ireland", rate = value / population * 1e5) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate, count = value)
admissions <- bind_rows(admissions_scotland, admissions_england, admissions_ireland)
print(count(admissions, jurisdiction))

# First stage: sales per adult (MESAS 2022), off-trade price bands, Irish per-capita (ASD01)
sales_uk <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "mesas_sales")
price_bands <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "mesas_price_bands") %>%
  mutate(lower_ppu = as.numeric(str_extract(price_band_ppu, "\\d+(\\.\\d+)?")),
         lower_ppu = if_else(str_detect(price_band_ppu, "^<"), 0, lower_ppu))
sales_ireland <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "cso_asd01_percapita") %>%
  select(year, litres_per_capita_15plus = value)
phs_2026 <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "phs2026_report_values")
print(sales_uk %>% filter(year >= 2014))

# Australia: alcohol-induced deaths by state, year of occurrence (persons)
australia <- read_excel(raw_file, sheet = "abs_state_alcohol") %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons", state != "Australia (f)")
print(count(australia, state))

# Cause-specific deaths (H9): counts by age, Scotland / England / North East / North West
raw_cause_file <- "03_mup_raw_cause.xlsx"
cause_deaths_age <- read_excel(raw_cause_file, sheet = "deaths_cause_age") %>%
  filter(
    (area == "Scotland" & source != "NRS 2025 Table 8") |
      (area == "England" & ((source == "ONS individual cause 2022" & year <= 2021) |
                              (source == "Nomis NM_161_1" & year >= 2022))) |
      (area %in% c("North East", "North West") & ((source == "ONS adhoc 11797" & year <= 2018) |
                                                    (source == "Nomis NM_161_1" & year >= 2019)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(cause = case_when(
    icd10 == "K70" ~ "k70",
    icd10 == "F10" ~ "f10",
    icd10 %in% c("X45", "X65", "Y15") ~ "poisoning",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  age_group = if_else(age_group %in% c("85-89", "90+"), "85+", age_group),
  area = if_else(area %in% c("North East", "North West"), "Eng: NE+NW", area)) %>%
  group_by(area, year, cause, age_group) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop")
print(count(cause_deaths_age, area, cause) %>% head(12))

# Scotland totals by cause from NRS Table 8 (all years, used for crude rates)
cause_scotland_total <- read_excel(raw_cause_file, sheet = "nrs_cause_total") %>%
  mutate(cause = case_when(
    icd10 == "K70" ~ "k70",
    icd10 == "F10" ~ "f10",
    icd10 %in% c("X45", "X65", "Y15") ~ "poisoning",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  group_by(area, year, cause) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop")

# Populations by age (Nomis NM_31_1), NE and NW combined
cause_pop_age <- read_excel(raw_cause_file, sheet = "population_age") %>%
  mutate(area = if_else(area %in% c("North East", "North West"), "Eng: NE+NW", area),
         age_group = case_when(
           age_label == "Aged under 1 year" ~ "<1",
           age_label == "Aged 85 and over" ~ "85+",
           TRUE ~ sprintf("%02d-%02d",
                          as.numeric(str_extract(age_label, "\\d+")),
                          as.numeric(str_extract(age_label, "\\d+(?= years)")))
         )) %>%
  group_by(area, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(population = sum(population), .groups = "drop")
print(sort(unique(cause_pop_age$age_group)))

# ESP2013 weights on the harmonised age groups (85+ = 2500)
esp_2013_cause <- tibble(
  age_group = c("<1", "01-04", "05-09", "10-14", "15-19", "20-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-44",
                "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+"),
  esp_weight = esp_2013$esp_weight
)

# Crude rates per 100,000 (H9 primary, frozen hierarchy level 3, FLAG)
cause_crude <- bind_rows(
  cause_scotland_total,
  cause_deaths_age %>% filter(area != "Scotland") %>%
    group_by(area, year, cause) %>% summarise(deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop")
) %>%
  inner_join(cause_pop_age %>% group_by(area, year) %>% summarise(population = sum(population), .groups = "drop"),
             by = c("area", "year")) %>%
  mutate(rate = deaths / population * 1e5, rate_type = "crude") %>%
  filter(year >= 2007, year <= 2024)
print(count(cause_crude, area, cause))

# ESP2013 ASMR (exploratory; Scotland 2022 has no age breakdown -> missing)
cause_asmr <- cause_deaths_age %>%
  inner_join(cause_pop_age, by = c("area", "year", "age_group")) %>%
  inner_join(esp_2013_cause, by = "age_group") %>%
  group_by(area, year, cause) %>%
  summarise(rate = sum(deaths / population * 1e5 * esp_weight) / sum(esp_weight),
            deaths = sum(deaths), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rate_type = "asmr_esp2013") %>%
  filter(year >= 2007, year <= 2024)
print(count(cause_asmr, area, cause))

# Validation: computed England ASMR vs Nomis published ASMR (2013-2024, single codes)
cause_validation <- cause_deaths_age %>%
  filter(area == "England", cause %in% c("k70", "f10")) %>%
  inner_join(cause_pop_age, by = c("area", "year", "age_group")) %>%
  inner_join(esp_2013_cause, by = "age_group") %>%
  group_by(year, cause) %>%
  summarise(asmr_computed = sum(deaths / population * 1e5 * esp_weight) / sum(esp_weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(read_excel(raw_cause_file, sheet = "nomis_asmr_published") %>%
               filter(area == "England", icd10 %in% c("K70", "F10")) %>%
               mutate(cause = tolower(icd10)) %>% select(year, cause, asmr_published),
             by = c("year", "cause")) %>%
  mutate(ratio = asmr_computed / asmr_published)
print(summary(cause_validation$ratio))

# Write clean workbook (one sheet per source + harmonised panel)
write_xlsx(
  list(panel = panel,
       scotland_monthly = scotland_monthly,
       deprivation = deprivation,
       admissions = admissions,
       sales_uk = sales_uk,
       price_bands = price_bands,
       sales_ireland = sales_ireland,
       phs_2026_report = phs_2026,
       australia = australia,
       ireland_validation = ie_check,
       cause_crude = cause_crude,
       cause_asmr = cause_asmr,
       cause_validation = cause_validation),
  "clean_data.xlsx"
)
```

# H0. POSITIVE CONTROL: SCOTLAND 2018 VS ENGLAND

## H0.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H0.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h0_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons",
         jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England"), year <= 2024) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

h0_df_wyper <- h0_df %>% filter(year >= 2012, year <= 2020)
h0_df_main <- h0_df %>% filter(year >= 2012)
h0_df_2007 <- h0_df %>% filter(year >= 2007)

print(nrow(h0_df_wyper))
print(nrow(h0_df_main))
print(h0_df_main)
```

## H0.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H0.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# (a) Wyper-matched window 2012-2020, no COVID term
h0_model_wyper <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup,
  data = h0_df_wyper
)
h0_vcov_wyper <- NeweyWest(h0_model_wyper, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_wyper))
print(coeftest(h0_model_wyper, vcov = h0_vcov_wyper)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_wyper, vcov = h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(h0_model_wyper))["mup", ])
print(100 * (exp(coef(h0_model_wyper)["mup"]) - 1))
print(100 * (exp(coefci(h0_model_wyper, vcov = h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(h0_model_wyper))["mup", ]) - 1))

# (b) Primary specification 2012-2024 with COVID term (start moved from 2007, see DECISIONS.md)
h0_model_main <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid,
  data = h0_df_main
)
h0_vcov_main <- NeweyWest(h0_model_main, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_main))
print(coeftest(h0_model_main, vcov = h0_vcov_main)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_main, vcov = h0_vcov_main, df = df.residual(h0_model_main))["mup", ])
print(100 * (exp(coef(h0_model_main)["mup"]) - 1))
print(100 * (exp(coefci(h0_model_main, vcov = h0_vcov_main, df = df.residual(h0_model_main))["mup", ]) - 1))

# Gate: point estimate inside published 95% CI (-18.4 to -8.3)
h0_gate <- tibble(
  spec = c("Wyper window 2012-2020", "Primary 2012-2024"),
  estimate_pct = c(100 * (exp(coef(h0_model_wyper)["mup"]) - 1),
                   100 * (exp(coef(h0_model_main)["mup"]) - 1))
) %>%
  mutate(inside_published_ci = estimate_pct >= -18.4 & estimate_pct <= -8.3)
print(h0_gate)
```

## H0.3 Robustness

```{r}
################################################################################
# H0.3 Robustness
################################################################################

h0_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)

# Original pre-specified window 2007-2024 (failed placebo; kept for transparency)
h0_model_2007 <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid,
  data = h0_df_2007
)
h0_vcov_2007 <- NeweyWest(h0_model_2007, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_2007))
print(coeftest(h0_model_2007, vcov = h0_vcov_2007)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_2007, vcov = h0_vcov_2007, df = df.residual(h0_model_2007))["mup", ])

# Placebo 2016 on the 2007 window (diagnostic that motivated the 2012 start)
h0_model_placebo_2007 <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup_placebo,
  data = h0_df_2007 %>% filter(year <= 2017) %>% mutate(mup_placebo = if_else(year >= 2016, 1, 0))
)
h0_vcov_placebo_2007 <- NeweyWest(h0_model_placebo_2007, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_placebo_2007))
print(coeftest(h0_model_placebo_2007, vcov = h0_vcov_placebo_2007)["mup_placebo", ])

# Trend from pre-period only (slope-change term); average effect over full post years 2019-2024
h0_df_slope <- h0_df_main %>%
  mutate(post_slope = if_else(year >= 2018, year - 2018, 0))
h0_model_slope <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope + covid,
  data = h0_df_slope
)
h0_vcov_slope <- NeweyWest(h0_model_slope, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_slope))
h0_L_slope <- c(0, 0, 1, mean(2019:2024 - 2018), 0)
h0_slope_avg <- tibble(
  estimate = sum(h0_L_slope * coef(h0_model_slope)),
  se = sqrt(as.numeric(t(h0_L_slope) %*% h0_vcov_slope %*% h0_L_slope))
) %>%
  mutate(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df.residual(h0_model_slope)) * se) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df.residual(h0_model_slope)) * se) - 1))
print(h0_slope_avg)

# Exclude 2020-2021
h0_model_nocovid <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup,
  data = filter(h0_df_main, !year %in% 2020:2021)
)
h0_vcov_nocovid <- NeweyWest(h0_model_nocovid, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_nocovid))
print(coeftest(h0_model_nocovid, vcov = h0_vcov_nocovid)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_nocovid, vcov = h0_vcov_nocovid, df = df.residual(h0_model_nocovid))["mup", ])

# Placebo date 2016 (pre-period only, 2012-2017)
h0_df_placebo <- h0_df_main %>%
  filter(year <= 2017) %>%
  mutate(mup_placebo = if_else(year >= 2016, 1, 0))
h0_model_placebo <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup_placebo,
  data = h0_df_placebo
)
h0_vcov_placebo <- NeweyWest(h0_model_placebo, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_placebo))
print(coeftest(h0_model_placebo, vcov = h0_vcov_placebo)["mup_placebo", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_placebo, vcov = h0_vcov_placebo, df = df.residual(h0_model_placebo))["mup_placebo", ])

# Alternative control: North East + North West England
h0_df_nenw <- h0_panel %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons", jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "Eng: NE+NW")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(`Eng: NE+NW`),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
h0_model_nenw <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid,
  data = h0_df_nenw
)
h0_vcov_nenw <- NeweyWest(h0_model_nenw, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_nenw))
print(coeftest(h0_model_nenw, vcov = h0_vcov_nenw)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_nenw, vcov = h0_vcov_nenw, df = df.residual(h0_model_nenw))["mup", ])

# Sex-specific
h0_df_sex <- h0_panel %>%
  filter(sex %in% c("Males", "Females"), jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, sex, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
h0_model_males <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid,
  data = filter(h0_df_sex, sex == "Males")
)
h0_vcov_males <- NeweyWest(h0_model_males, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_males))
print(coeftest(h0_model_males, vcov = h0_vcov_males)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_males, vcov = h0_vcov_males, df = df.residual(h0_model_males))["mup", ])
h0_model_females <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid,
  data = filter(h0_df_sex, sex == "Females")
)
h0_vcov_females <- NeweyWest(h0_model_females, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h0_model_females))
print(coeftest(h0_model_females, vcov = h0_vcov_females)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h0_model_females, vcov = h0_vcov_females, df = df.residual(h0_model_females))["mup", ])

# Placebo-in-space: each English region vs England, same model (Scotland's dates)
h0_placebo_space <- h0_panel %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons", str_detect(jurisdiction, "^Eng: "), jurisdiction != "Eng: NE+NW") %>%
  select(region = jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  inner_join(filter(h0_panel, sex == "Persons", jurisdiction == "England") %>% select(year, england = rate),
             by = "year") %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(rate) - log(england),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(b = coef(lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = .x))["mup"])) %>%
  ungroup()
print(h0_placebo_space)
print(mean(abs(h0_placebo_space$b) >= abs(coef(h0_model_main)["mup"])))

# Demeaned synthetic control: Scotland, donors = 9 English regions + Northern Ireland, fit 2012-2017
h0_sc_wide <- h0_panel %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons",
         jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "Northern Ireland") |
           (str_detect(jurisdiction, "^Eng: ") & jurisdiction != "Eng: NE+NW")) %>%
  mutate(log_rate = log(rate)) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, log_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = log_rate) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~ .x - mean(.x[year <= 2017])))
h0_sc_donors <- setdiff(names(h0_sc_wide), c("year", "Scotland"))
h0_sc_pre <- h0_sc_wide %>% filter(year <= 2017)
h0_sc_X <- as.matrix(h0_sc_pre[, h0_sc_donors])
h0_sc_y <- h0_sc_pre$Scotland
h0_sc_fit <- solve.QP(
  Dmat = t(h0_sc_X) %*% h0_sc_X + diag(1e-8, length(h0_sc_donors)),
  dvec = as.vector(t(h0_sc_X) %*% h0_sc_y),
  Amat = cbind(rep(1, length(h0_sc_donors)), diag(length(h0_sc_donors))),
  bvec = c(1, rep(0, length(h0_sc_donors))),
  meq = 1
)
h0_sc_weights <- tibble(donor = h0_sc_donors, weight = round(h0_sc_fit$solution, 3))
print(h0_sc_weights)
h0_sc_series <- h0_sc_wide %>%
  mutate(synthetic = as.vector(as.matrix(h0_sc_wide[, h0_sc_donors]) %*% h0_sc_fit$solution),
         gap = Scotland - synthetic)
print(h0_sc_series %>% select(year, Scotland, synthetic, gap))
h0_sc_effect <- h0_sc_series %>%
  summarise(pre_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[year <= 2017]^2)),
            post_gap = mean(gap[year >= 2019]),
            pre_gap = mean(gap[year <= 2017])) %>%
  mutate(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(post_gap - pre_gap) - 1))
print(h0_sc_effect)

# Leave-one-donor-out synthetic control
h0_sc_loo <- tibble(dropped = h0_sc_donors) %>%
  group_by(dropped) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    keep <- setdiff(h0_sc_donors, .y$dropped)
    X <- as.matrix(h0_sc_pre[, keep])
    w <- solve.QP(t(X) %*% X + diag(1e-8, length(keep)), as.vector(t(X) %*% h0_sc_y),
                  cbind(rep(1, length(keep)), diag(length(keep))), c(1, rep(0, length(keep))), meq = 1)$solution
    synth <- as.vector(as.matrix(h0_sc_wide[, keep]) %*% w)
    gap <- h0_sc_wide$Scotland - synth
    tibble(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year >= 2019]) - mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year <= 2017])) - 1))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
print(h0_sc_loo)
print(range(h0_sc_loo$effect_pct))

# Synthetic-control placebo-in-space (each donor treated, others as donors): post/pre RMSPE ratio
h0_sc_placebo <- tibble(unit = c("Scotland", h0_sc_donors)) %>%
  group_by(unit) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    pool <- setdiff(h0_sc_donors, .y$unit)
    X <- as.matrix(h0_sc_pre[, pool])
    y <- h0_sc_pre[[.y$unit]]
    w <- solve.QP(t(X) %*% X + diag(1e-8, length(pool)), as.vector(t(X) %*% y),
                  cbind(rep(1, length(pool)), diag(length(pool))), c(1, rep(0, length(pool))), meq = 1)$solution
    gap <- h0_sc_wide[[.y$unit]] - as.vector(as.matrix(h0_sc_wide[, pool]) %*% w)
    tibble(pre_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year <= 2017]^2)),
           post_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year >= 2019]^2)),
           effect_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year >= 2019]) - mean(gap[h0_sc_wide$year <= 2017])) - 1))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ratio = post_rmspe / pre_rmspe) %>%
  arrange(desc(ratio))
print(h0_sc_placebo)
print(mean(h0_sc_placebo$ratio >= h0_sc_placebo$ratio[h0_sc_placebo$unit == "Scotland"]))
```

# H2. POWER (MINIMUM DETECTABLE EFFECT)

## H2.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H2.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h2_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome %in% c("alcohol_specific", "k70"), sex == "Persons", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)

h2_df_scotland <- h2_panel %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England), year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

h2_df_wales <- h2_panel %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", jurisdiction %in% c("Wales", "England")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Wales) - log(England), year_c = year - 2020,
         mup = case_when(year < 2020 ~ 0, year == 2020 ~ 10 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

h2_df_ireland <- h2_panel %>%
  filter((jurisdiction == "Ireland" & outcome == "alcohol_specific") |
           (jurisdiction == "Northern Ireland" & outcome == "alcohol_specific")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Ireland) - log(`Northern Ireland`), year_c = year - 2022,
         mup = if_else(year >= 2022, 1, 0),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

print(nrow(h2_df_scotland))
print(nrow(h2_df_wales))
print(nrow(h2_df_ireland))
```

## H2.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H2.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Pre-period residual SD (trend-only model on pre-policy years)
h2_sigma_scotland <- sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h2_df_scotland, year < 2018)))
h2_sigma_wales <- sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h2_df_wales, year < 2020)))
h2_sigma_ireland <- sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h2_df_ireland, year < 2022)))

# Design-based SE of the level-change term in the primary model
h2_X_scotland <- model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h2_df_scotland)
h2_X_wales <- model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h2_df_wales)
h2_X_ireland <- model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h2_df_ireland)

h2_power <- tibble(
  jurisdiction = c("Scotland", "Wales", "Ireland"),
  control = c("England", "England", "Northern Ireland"),
  pre_years = c(sum(h2_df_scotland$year < 2018), sum(h2_df_wales$year < 2020), sum(h2_df_ireland$year < 2022)),
  post_years = c(sum(h2_df_scotland$mup > 0), sum(h2_df_wales$mup > 0), sum(h2_df_ireland$mup > 0)),
  sigma_pre = c(h2_sigma_scotland, h2_sigma_wales, h2_sigma_ireland),
  se_mup = c(h2_sigma_scotland * sqrt(solve(crossprod(h2_X_scotland))["mup", "mup"]),
             h2_sigma_wales * sqrt(solve(crossprod(h2_X_wales))["mup", "mup"]),
             h2_sigma_ireland * sqrt(solve(crossprod(h2_X_ireland))["mup", "mup"]))
) %>%
  mutate(mde_log = (qnorm(0.975) + qnorm(0.80)) * se_mup,
         mde_pct = 100 * (1 - exp(-mde_log)),
         powered_for_13pct = if_else(mde_pct <= 13, "powered", "underpowered"))
print(h2_power)
```

```{r}
)
h3_vcov_2007 <- NeweyWest(h3_model_2007, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h3_model_2007))
print(coeftest(h3_model_2007, vcov = h3_vcov_2007)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h3_model_2007, vcov = h3_vcov_2007, df = df.residual(h3_model_2007))["mup", ])

# Trend from pre-period only (slope-change term); average effect over full post years 2021-2024
h3_df_slope <- h3_df %>%
  mutate(post_slope = if_else(year >= 2020, year - 2020, 0))
h3_model_slope <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope + covid,
  data = h3_df_slope
)
h3_vcov_slope <- NeweyWest(h3_model_slope, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h3_model_slope))
h3_L_slope <- c(0, 0, 1, mean(2021:2024 - 2020), 0)
h3_slope_avg <- tibble(
  estimate = sum(h3_L_slope * coef(h3_model_slope)),
  se = sqrt(as.numeric(t(h3_L_slope) %*% h3_vcov_slope %*% h3_L_slope))
) %>%
  mutate(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df.residual(h3_model_slope)) * se) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df.residual(h3_model_slope)) * se) - 1))
print(h3_slope_avg)

# Demeaned synthetic control: Wales, donors = 9 English regions + Northern Ireland, fit 2012-2019
h3_sc_wide <- h3_panel %>%
  filter(sex == "Persons",
         jurisdiction %in% c("Wales", "Northern Ireland") |
           (str_detect(jurisdiction, "^Eng: ") & jurisdiction != "Eng: NE+NW")) %>%
  mutate(log_rate = log(rate)) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, log_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = log_rate) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~ .x - mean(.x[year <= 2019])))
h3_sc_donors <- setdiff(names(h3_sc_wide), c("year", "Wales"))
h3_sc_pre <- h3_sc_wide %>% filter(year <= 2019)
h3_sc_X <- as.matrix(h3_sc_pre[, h3_sc_donors])
h3_sc_fit <- solve.QP(
  Dmat = t(h3_sc_X) %*% h3_sc_X + diag(1e-8, length(h3_sc_donors)),
  dvec = as.vector(t(h3_sc_X) %*% h3_sc_pre$Wales),
  Amat = cbind(rep(1, length(h3_sc_donors)), diag(length(h3_sc_donors))),
  bvec = c(1, rep(0, length(h3_sc_donors))),
  meq = 1
)
h3_sc_weights <- tibble(donor = h3_sc_donors, weight = round(h3_sc_fit$solution, 3))
print(h3_sc_weights)
h3_sc_series <- h3_sc_wide %>%
  mutate(synthetic = as.vector(as.matrix(h3_sc_wide[, h3_sc_donors]) %*% h3_sc_fit$solution),
         gap = Wales - synthetic)
h3_sc_effect <- h3_sc_series %>%
  summarise(pre_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[year <= 2019]^2)),
            post_gap = mean(gap[year >= 2021]),
            pre_gap = mean(gap[year <= 2019])) %>%
  mutate(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(post_gap - pre_gap) - 1))
print(h3_sc_effect)

# Leave-one-donor-out
h3_sc_loo <- tibble(dropped = h3_sc_donors) %>%
  group_by(dropped) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    keep <- setdiff(h3_sc_donors, .y$dropped)
    X <- as.matrix(h3_sc_pre[, keep])
    w <- solve.QP(t(X) %*% X + diag(1e-8, length(keep)), as.vector(t(X) %*% h3_sc_pre$Wales),
                  cbind(rep(1, length(keep)), diag(length(keep))), c(1, rep(0, length(keep))), meq = 1)$solution
    gap <- h3_sc_wide$Wales - as.vector(as.matrix(h3_sc_wide[, keep]) %*% w)
    tibble(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year >= 2021]) - mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year <= 2019])) - 1))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
print(h3_sc_loo)
print(range(h3_sc_loo$effect_pct))

# Synthetic-control placebo-in-space
h3_sc_placebo <- tibble(unit = c("Wales", h3_sc_donors)) %>%
  group_by(unit) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    pool <- setdiff(h3_sc_donors, .y$unit)
    X <- as.matrix(h3_sc_pre[, pool])
    w <- solve.QP(t(X) %*% X + diag(1e-8, length(pool)), as.vector(t(X) %*% h3_sc_pre[[.y$unit]]),
                  cbind(rep(1, length(pool)), diag(length(pool))), c(1, rep(0, length(pool))), meq = 1)$solution
    gap <- h3_sc_wide[[.y$unit]] - as.vector(as.matrix(h3_sc_wide[, pool]) %*% w)
    tibble(pre_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year <= 2019]^2)),
           post_rmspe = sqrt(mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year >= 2021]^2)),
           effect_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year >= 2021]) - mean(gap[h3_sc_wide$year <= 2019])) - 1))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ratio = post_rmspe / pre_rmspe) %>%
  arrange(desc(ratio))
print(h3_sc_placebo)
print(mean(h3_sc_placebo$ratio >= h3_sc_placebo$ratio[h3_sc_placebo$unit == "Wales"]))
```

# H5. Q1 POOLED: RANDOM-EFFECTS ACROSS SCOTLAND, WALES, IRELAND

## H5.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H5.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h5_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)

h5_df_scotland <- h5_panel %>%
  filter(jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England), year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
h5_df_wales <- h5_panel %>%
  filter(jurisdiction %in% c("Wales", "England")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Wales) - log(England), year_c = year - 2020,
         mup = case_when(year < 2020 ~ 0, year == 2020 ~ 10 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
h5_df_ireland <- h5_panel %>%
  filter(jurisdiction %in% c("Ireland", "Northern Ireland")) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Ireland) - log(`Northern Ireland`), year_c = year - 2022,
         mup = if_else(year >= 2022, 1, 0),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
print(nrow(h5_df_scotland))
print(nrow(h5_df_wales))
print(nrow(h5_df_ireland))
```

## H5.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H5.2 Analysis
################################################################################

h5_model_scotland <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h5_df_scotland)
h5_model_wales <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h5_df_wales)
h5_model_ireland <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h5_df_ireland)

h5_effects <- tibble(
  jurisdiction = c("Scotland", "Wales", "Ireland"),
  yi = c(coef(h5_model_scotland)["mup"], coef(h5_model_wales)["mup"], coef(h5_model_ireland)["mup"]),
  sei = c(sqrt(NeweyWest(h5_model_scotland, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)["mup", "mup"]),
          sqrt(NeweyWest(h5_model_wales, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)["mup", "mup"]),
          sqrt(NeweyWest(h5_model_ireland, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)["mup", "mup"]))
)
print(h5_effects)

h5_model_pooled <- rma(
  yi = yi, sei = sei,
  data = h5_effects,
  method = "REML"
)
print(summary(h5_model_pooled))
print(100 * (exp(c(h5_model_pooled$b, h5_model_pooled$ci.lb, h5_model_pooled$ci.ub)) - 1))
```

## H5.3 Robustness

```{r}

# H5.3 Robustness
################################################################################

  yi = yi, sei = sei,
  data = filter(h5_effects, jurisdiction != "Scotland"),
  method = "REML"
)
print(summary(h5_model_replication))
print(100 * (exp(c(h5_model_replication$b, h5_model_replication$ci.lb, h5_model_replication$ci.ub)) - 1))

# Fixed-effect pooled
```

# H6. Q2 DOSE: SCOTLAND 50P -> 65P (30 SEP 2024)

## H6.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H6.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h6_monthly <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "scotland_monthly") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         t = (as.numeric(format(date, "%Y")) - 2018) * 12 + as.numeric(format(date, "%m")),
         month_of_year = factor(format(date, "%m")),
         step_50p = if_else(date >= as.Date("2018-05-01"), 1, 0),
         step_65p = if_else(date >= as.Date("2024-10-01"), 1, 0),
         covid = if_else(date >= as.Date("2020-03-01") & date <= as.Date("2021-12-01"), 1, 0))

h6_df_50p_era <- h6_monthly %>% filter(date >= as.Date("2018-05-01"))
h6_df_long <- h6_monthly %>% filter(date >= as.Date("2012-01-01"))

h6_annual <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons",
         jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England"), year >= 2012, year <= 2024) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup_50p = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         mup_65p = case_when(year < 2024 ~ 0, year == 2024 ~ 3 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

print(nrow(h6_df_50p_era))
print(sum(h6_df_50p_era$step_65p))
print(nrow(h6_annual))
```

## H6.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H6.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary: monthly ITS within the 50p era (May 2018 - Dec 2025), step at Oct 2024
h6_model_monthly <- lm(
  log(rate) ~ t + month_of_year + covid + step_65p,
  data = h6_df_50p_era
)
h6_vcov_monthly <- NeweyWest(h6_model_monthly, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h6_model_monthly))
print(coeftest(h6_model_monthly, vcov = h6_vcov_monthly)["step_65p", ])
print(coefci(h6_model_monthly, vcov = h6_vcov_monthly, df = df.residual(h6_model_monthly))["step_65p", ])
print(100 * (exp(coef(h6_model_monthly)["step_65p"]) - 1))
print(100 * (exp(coefci(h6_model_monthly, vcov = h6_vcov_monthly, df = df.residual(h6_model_monthly))["step_65p", ]) - 1))

# MDE for the 65p step (pre-65p residual SD, design-based SE)
h6_sigma_pre <- sigma(lm(log(rate) ~ t + month_of_year + covid,
                         data = filter(h6_df_50p_era, step_65p == 0)))
h6_X <- model.matrix(~ t + month_of_year + covid + step_65p, data = h6_df_50p_era)
h6_se_design <- h6_sigma_pre * sqrt(solve(crossprod(h6_X))["step_65p", "step_65p"])
h6_mde_pct <- 100 * (1 - exp(-(qnorm(0.975) + qnorm(0.80)) * h6_se_design))
print(h6_mde_pct)

# Controlled annual (vs England, through 2024 = 3 post-65p months only)
h6_model_annual <- lm(
  log_gap ~ year_c + mup_50p + mup_65p + covid,
  data = h6_annual
)
h6_vcov_annual <- NeweyWest(h6_model_annual, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h6_model_annual))
print(coeftest(h6_model_annual, vcov = h6_vcov_annual)["mup_65p", ])
print(coefci(h6_model_annual, vcov = h6_vcov_annual, df = df.residual(h6_model_annual))["mup_65p", ])
```

## H6.3 Robustness

```{r}
################################################################################
# H6.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Long series 2012-2025 with both steps
h6_model_long <- lm(
  log(rate) ~ t + month_of_year + covid + step_50p + step_65p,
  data = h6_df_long
)
h6_vcov_long <- NeweyWest(h6_model_long, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h6_model_long))
print(coeftest(h6_model_long, vcov = h6_vcov_long)["step_65p", ])
print(coefci(h6_model_long, vcov = h6_vcov_long, df = df.residual(h6_model_long))["step_65p", ])

# Exclude COVID months, 50p era only
h6_model_nocovid <- lm(
  log(rate) ~ t + month_of_year + step_65p,
  data = filter(h6_df_50p_era, covid == 0)
)
h6_vcov_nocovid <- NeweyWest(h6_model_nocovid, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h6_model_nocovid))
print(coeftest(h6_model_nocovid, vcov = h6_vcov_nocovid)["step_65p", ])
print(coefci(h6_model_nocovid, vcov = h6_vcov_nocovid, df = df.residual(h6_model_nocovid))["step_65p", ])

# Placebo step Oct 2022 (data up to Sep 2024 only)
h6_df_placebo <- h6_df_50p_era %>%
  filter(step_65p == 0) %>%
  mutate(step_placebo = if_else(date >= as.Date("2022-10-01"), 1, 0))
h6_model_placebo <- lm(
  log(rate) ~ t + month_of_year + covid + step_placebo,
  data = h6_df_placebo
)
h6_vcov_placebo <- NeweyWest(h6_model_placebo, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h6_model_placebo))
print(coeftest(h6_model_placebo, vcov = h6_vcov_placebo)["step_placebo", ])
print(coefci(h6_model_placebo, vcov = h6_vcov_placebo, df = df.residual(h6_model_placebo))["step_placebo", ])
```


```{r}

  data = h6_df_placebo_2024
)

             df = df.residual(h6_model_placebo_2024))["step_placebo_2024", ])
```

# H7. Q3 DEPRIVATION: SCOTLAND SIMD VS ENGLAND IMD QUINTILES

## H7.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H7.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h7_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "deprivation") %>%
  filter(year >= 2012, year <= 2024) %>%
  select(nation, year, quintile, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = nation, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England),
         year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))

print(nrow(h7_df))
print(table(h7_df$quintile))
```

## H7.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H7.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Quintile 1 (most deprived)
h7_model_q1 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h7_df, quintile == 1))
h7_vcov_q1 <- NeweyWest(h7_model_q1, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h7_model_q1))
print(coeftest(h7_model_q1, vcov = h7_vcov_q1)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h7_model_q1, vcov = h7_vcov_q1, df = df.residual(h7_model_q1))["mup", ])

# Quintile 2
h7_model_q2 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h7_df, quintile == 2))
h7_vcov_q2 <- NeweyWest(h7_model_q2, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h7_model_q2))
print(coeftest(h7_model_q2, vcov = h7_vcov_q2)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h7_model_q2, vcov = h7_vcov_q2, df = df.residual(h7_model_q2))["mup", ])

# Quintile 3
h7_model_q3 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h7_df, quintile == 3))
h7_vcov_q3 <- NeweyWest(h7_model_q3, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h7_model_q3))
print(coeftest(h7_model_q3, vcov = h7_vcov_q3)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h7_model_q3, vcov = h7_vcov_q3, df = df.residual(h7_model_q3))["mup", ])

# Quintile 4
h7_model_q4 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h7_df, quintile == 4))
h7_vcov_q4 <- NeweyWest(h7_model_q4, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h7_model_q4))
print(coeftest(h7_model_q4, vcov = h7_vcov_q4)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h7_model_q4, vcov = h7_vcov_q4, df = df.residual(h7_model_q4))["mup", ])

# Quintile 5 (least deprived)
h7_model_q5 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h7_df, quintile == 5))
h7_vcov_q5 <- NeweyWest(h7_model_q5, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h7_model_q5))
print(coeftest(h7_model_q5, vcov = h7_vcov_q5)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h7_model_q5, vcov = h7_vcov_q5, df = df.residual(h7_model_q5))["mup", ])

# Gradient: meta-regression of quintile effects on quintile number
h7_gradient <- tibble(
  quintile = 1:5,
  yi = c(coef(h7_model_q1)["mup"], coef(h7_model_q2)["mup"], coef(h7_model_q3)["mup"],
         coef(h7_model_q4)["mup"], coef(h7_model_q5)["mup"]),
  sei = c(sqrt(h7_vcov_q1["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h7_vcov_q2["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h7_vcov_q3["mup", "mup"]),
          sqrt(h7_vcov_q4["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h7_vcov_q5["mup", "mup"]))
) %>%
  mutate(effect_pct = 100 * (exp(yi) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(yi - 1.96 * sei) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(yi + 1.96 * sei) - 1))
print(h7_gradient)
h7_model_gradient <- rma(yi = yi, sei = sei, mods = ~ quintile, data = h7_gradient, method = "FE")
print(summary(h7_model_gradient))
```

# H8. MULTIVERSE: SCOTLAND 2018, ALL ALCOHOL-SPECIFIC DEATHS

## H8.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H8.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

h8_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons",
         jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "England", "Eng: NE+NW"), year >= 2007, year <= 2024) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = rate)

# Frozen grid (multiverse_specs.md): 8 x 5 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 320
h8_grid <- expand_grid(
  start = 2007:2014,
  end = 2020:2024,
  trend = c("full", "pre-only"),
  control = c("England", "NE+NW"),
  covid = c("indicator", "exclude")
)
print(nrow(h8_panel))
print(nrow(h8_grid))
```

## H8.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H8.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# CITS for every spec (same model as H0; pre-only trend adds post_slope)
h8_cits <- h8_grid %>%
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(start, end, trend, control, covid), \(start, end, trend, control, covid) {
    d <- h8_panel %>%
      filter(year >= start, year <= end) %>%
      mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(if (control == "England") England else `Eng: NE+NW`),
             year_c = year - 2018,
             mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
             post_slope = pmax(0, year - 2018),
             covid_term = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
    if (covid == "exclude") d <- filter(d, !year %in% 2020:2021)
    m <- if (trend == "full" & covid == "indicator") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid_term, data = d) else
      if (trend == "full" & covid == "exclude") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup, data = d) else
        if (trend == "pre-only" & covid == "indicator") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope + covid_term, data = d) else
          lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope, data = d)
    if (any(is.na(coef(m))) || df.residual(m) < 1) return(tibble(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, dropped = TRUE))
    v <- NeweyWest(m, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
    L <- setNames(rep(0, length(coef(m))), names(coef(m)))
    L["mup"] <- 1
    if (trend == "pre-only") L["post_slope"] <- mean(2019:end - 2018)
    tibble(estimate = sum(L * coef(m)), se = sqrt(as.numeric(t(L) %*% v %*% L)), df = df.residual(m), dropped = FALSE)
  })) %>%
  unnest(fit) %>%
  mutate(p = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / se), df),
         effect_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         wyper = start == 2012 & end == 2020 & control == "England" & trend == "full")
print(count(h8_cits, dropped))
print(filter(h8_cits, dropped))
print(filter(h8_cits, wyper))

# Summary: overall and by each dimension
h8_cits_kept <- filter(h8_cits, !dropped)
h8_summary_overall <- h8_cits_kept %>%
  summarise(n_specs = n(),
            median_pct = median(effect_pct),
            q25_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.25),
            q75_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.75),
            pct_negative = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0),
            pct_negative_p05 = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0 & p < 0.05)) %>%
  mutate(dimension = "overall", level = "all")
h8_summary_dims <- h8_cits_kept %>%
  mutate(across(c(start, end), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(start, end, trend, control, covid), names_to = "dimension", values_to = "level") %>%
  group_by(dimension, level) %>%
  summarise(n_specs = n(),
            median_pct = median(effect_pct),
            q25_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.25),
            q75_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.75),
            pct_negative = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0),
            pct_negative_p05 = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0 & p < 0.05),
            .groups = "drop")
h8_summary <- bind_rows(h8_summary_overall, h8_summary_dims) %>%
  select(dimension, level, everything())
print(h8_summary, n = 40)
```

## H8.3 Robustness

```{r}
################################################################################
# H8.3 Robustness: demeaned synthetic control over start x end (40 specs)
################################################################################

h8_sc_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel") %>%
  filter(outcome == "alcohol_specific", sex == "Persons", year >= 2007, year <= 2024,
         jurisdiction %in% c("Scotland", "Northern Ireland") |
           (str_detect(jurisdiction, "^Eng: ") & jurisdiction != "Eng: NE+NW")) %>%
  mutate(log_rate = log(rate)) %>%
  select(jurisdiction, year, log_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = jurisdiction, values_from = log_rate) %>%
  arrange(year)
h8_sc_units <- setdiff(names(h8_sc_panel), "year")

h8_sc <- expand_grid(start = 2007:2014, end = 2020:2024) %>%
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(start, end), \(start, end) {
    w_df <- h8_sc_panel %>%
      filter(year >= start, year <= end) %>%
      mutate(across(-year, ~ .x - mean(.x[year <= 2017])))
    placebo <- map_dfr(h8_sc_units, \(unit) {
      pool <- setdiff(h8_sc_units, c(unit, if (unit != "Scotland") "Scotland"))
      X <- as.matrix(w_df[w_df$year <= 2017, pool])
      w <- solve.QP(t(X) %*% X + diag(1e-8, length(pool)), as.vector(t(X) %*% w_df[[unit]][w_df$year <= 2017]),
                    cbind(rep(1, length(pool)), diag(length(pool))), c(1, rep(0, length(pool))), meq = 1)$solution
      gap <- w_df[[unit]] - as.vector(as.matrix(w_df[, pool]) %*% w)
      tibble(unit = unit,
             effect_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(gap[w_df$year >= 2019]) - mean(gap[w_df$year <= 2017])) - 1),
             ratio = sqrt(mean(gap[w_df$year >= 2019]^2)) / sqrt(mean(gap[w_df$year <= 2017]^2)))
    })
    tibble(effect_pct = placebo$effect_pct[placebo$unit == "Scotland"],
           placebo_p = mean(placebo$ratio >= placebo$ratio[placebo$unit == "Scotland"]))
  })) %>%
  unnest(fit)
print(h8_sc, n = 40)

h8_sc_summary <- bind_rows(
  h8_sc %>% mutate(dimension = "overall", level = "all"),
  h8_sc %>% mutate(dimension = "start", level = as.character(start)),
  h8_sc %>% mutate(dimension = "end", level = as.character(end))
) %>%
  group_by(dimension, level) %>%
  summarise(n_specs = n(),
            median_pct = median(effect_pct),
            q25_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.25),
            q75_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.75),
            pct_negative = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0),
            pct_placebo_p05 = 100 * mean(placebo_p < 0.05),
            .groups = "drop")
print(h8_sc_summary, n = 20)

# Reference point outside grid: H0 Wyper spec (no COVID term)
h8_reference_h0_wyper <- tibble(
  effect_pct = 100 * (exp(coef(h0_model_wyper)["mup"]) - 1),
  lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(coefci(h0_model_wyper, vcov = h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(h0_model_wyper))["mup", 1]) - 1),
  ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(coefci(h0_model_wyper, vcov = h0_vcov_wyper, df = df.residual(h0_model_wyper))["mup", 2]) - 1)
)
print(h8_reference_h0_wyper)

h8_multiverse <- list(cits = h8_cits, summary = h8_summary, sc = h8_sc, sc_summary = h8_sc_summary,
                      reference_h0_wyper = h8_reference_h0_wyper)
```

# H9. CAUSE-SPECIFIC SPLIT: K70, F10, ACUTE POISONING (SCOTLAND VS ENGLAND)

## H9.1 Data preparation

```{r}
################################################################################
# H9.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Crude rates (frozen hierarchy level 3; FLAG in DECISIONS.md)
h9_crude <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "cause_crude") %>%
  select(area, year, cause, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = area, values_from = rate) %>%
  mutate(year_c = year - 2018,
         mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
         covid = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0),
         log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(England))

h9_df_k70 <- h9_crude %>% filter(cause == "k70", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)
h9_df_f10 <- h9_crude %>% filter(cause == "f10", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)
h9_df_poisoning <- h9_crude %>% filter(cause == "poisoning", year >= 2012, year <= 2024)

print(nrow(h9_df_k70))
print(nrow(h9_df_f10))
print(nrow(h9_df_poisoning))
print(read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "cause_crude") %>%
        filter(year >= 2012) %>% group_by(area, cause) %>% summarise(min_deaths = min(deaths), .groups = "drop"))
```

## H9.2 Analysis

```{r}
################################################################################
# H9.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary 2012-2024: K70
h9_model_k70 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_k70)
h9_vcov_k70 <- NeweyWest(h9_model_k70, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_k70))
print(coeftest(h9_model_k70, vcov = h9_vcov_k70)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_k70, vcov = h9_vcov_k70, df = df.residual(h9_model_k70))["mup", ])

# Primary 2012-2024: F10
h9_model_f10 <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_f10)
h9_vcov_f10 <- NeweyWest(h9_model_f10, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_f10))
print(coeftest(h9_model_f10, vcov = h9_vcov_f10)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_f10, vcov = h9_vcov_f10, df = df.residual(h9_model_f10))["mup", ])

# Primary 2012-2024: acute poisoning (X45 + X65 + Y15)
h9_model_poisoning <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_poisoning)
h9_vcov_poisoning <- NeweyWest(h9_model_poisoning, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_poisoning))
print(coeftest(h9_model_poisoning, vcov = h9_vcov_poisoning)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_poisoning, vcov = h9_vcov_poisoning, df = df.residual(h9_model_poisoning))["mup", ])

# Wyper-matched 2012-2020, no COVID term: K70
h9_model_k70_wyper <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup, data = filter(h9_df_k70, year <= 2020))
h9_vcov_k70_wyper <- NeweyWest(h9_model_k70_wyper, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_k70_wyper))
print(coeftest(h9_model_k70_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_k70_wyper)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_k70_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_k70_wyper, df = df.residual(h9_model_k70_wyper))["mup", ])

# Wyper-matched 2012-2020, no COVID term: F10
h9_model_f10_wyper <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup, data = filter(h9_df_f10, year <= 2020))
h9_vcov_f10_wyper <- NeweyWest(h9_model_f10_wyper, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_f10_wyper))
print(coeftest(h9_model_f10_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_f10_wyper)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_f10_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_f10_wyper, df = df.residual(h9_model_f10_wyper))["mup", ])

# Wyper-matched 2012-2020, no COVID term: acute poisoning
h9_model_poisoning_wyper <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup, data = filter(h9_df_poisoning, year <= 2020))
h9_vcov_poisoning_wyper <- NeweyWest(h9_model_poisoning_wyper, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
print(summary(h9_model_poisoning_wyper))
print(coeftest(h9_model_poisoning_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_poisoning_wyper)["mup", ])
print(coefci(h9_model_poisoning_wyper, vcov = h9_vcov_poisoning_wyper,
             df = df.residual(h9_model_poisoning_wyper))["mup", ])

# Results table with Holm adjustment across the 3 primary tests
h9_table <- tibble(
  cause = c("k70", "f10", "poisoning"),
  estimate = c(coef(h9_model_k70)["mup"], coef(h9_model_f10)["mup"], coef(h9_model_poisoning)["mup"]),
  se = c(sqrt(h9_vcov_k70["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h9_vcov_f10["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h9_vcov_poisoning["mup", "mup"])),
  df = c(df.residual(h9_model_k70), df.residual(h9_model_f10), df.residual(h9_model_poisoning)),
  estimate_wyper = c(coef(h9_model_k70_wyper)["mup"], coef(h9_model_f10_wyper)["mup"], coef(h9_model_poisoning_wyper)["mup"]),
  se_wyper = c(sqrt(h9_vcov_k70_wyper["mup", "mup"]), sqrt(h9_vcov_f10_wyper["mup", "mup"]),
               sqrt(h9_vcov_poisoning_wyper["mup", "mup"])),
  df_wyper = c(df.residual(h9_model_k70_wyper), df.residual(h9_model_f10_wyper), df.residual(h9_model_poisoning_wyper))
) %>%
  mutate(p = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / se), df),
         p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"),
         effect_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         p_wyper = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate_wyper / se_wyper), df_wyper),
         effect_wyper_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate_wyper) - 1),
         lcl_wyper_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate_wyper - qt(0.975, df_wyper) * se_wyper) - 1),
         ucl_wyper_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate_wyper + qt(0.975, df_wyper) * se_wyper) - 1))

# MDE per cause (H2 method)
h9_mde <- tibble(
  cause = c("k70", "f10", "poisoning"),
  sigma_pre = c(sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h9_df_k70, year < 2018))),
                sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h9_df_f10, year < 2018))),
                sigma(lm(log_gap ~ year_c, data = filter(h9_df_poisoning, year < 2018)))),
  xtx_mup = c(solve(crossprod(model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_k70)))["mup", "mup"],
              solve(crossprod(model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_f10)))["mup", "mup"],
              solve(crossprod(model.matrix(~ year_c + mup + covid, data = h9_df_poisoning)))["mup", "mup"])
) %>%
  mutate(se_design = sigma_pre * sqrt(xtx_mup),
         mde_pct = 100 * (1 - exp(-(qnorm(0.975) + qnorm(0.80)) * se_design)),
         power_label = if_else(mde_pct <= 13, "powered", "UNDERPOWERED"))

h9_table <- h9_table %>% left_join(select(h9_mde, cause, mde_pct, power_label), by = "cause")
print(h9_table %>% select(cause, effect_pct, lcl_pct, ucl_pct, p, p_holm, effect_wyper_pct, lcl_wyper_pct,
                          ucl_wyper_pct, p_wyper, mde_pct, power_label))

# Pre-specified predictions P1-P3
h9_predictions <- h9_table %>%
  transmute(cause,
            prediction = c("P1: K70 falls", "P2: F10 falls", "P3: poisoning smaller or no effect"),
            uninformative = power_label == "UNDERPOWERED" & lcl_pct < -13 & ucl_pct > 0,
            supported = case_when(
              cause == "k70" ~ effect_pct < 0,
              cause == "f10" ~ effect_pct < 0,
              cause == "poisoning" ~ abs(effect_pct) < min(abs(effect_pct[cause != "poisoning"])) |
                (lcl_pct < 0 & ucl_pct > 0)
            )) %>%
  mutate(verdict = case_when(uninformative ~ "uninformative",
                             supported ~ "supported",
                             TRUE ~ "not supported"))
print(h9_predictions)
```

## H9.3 Robustness

```{r}
################################################################################
# H9.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Cause as an extra multiverse dimension (CITS only; crude rates; 3 x 320 = 960 specs)
h9_crude_wide <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "cause_crude") %>%
  select(area, year, cause, rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = area, values_from = rate)

h9_multiverse <- expand_grid(
  cause = c("k70", "f10", "poisoning"),
  start = 2007:2014,
  end = 2020:2024,
  trend = c("full", "pre-only"),
  control = c("England", "NE+NW"),
  covid = c("indicator", "exclude")
) %>%
  mutate(fit = pmap(list(cause, start, end, trend, control, covid), \(cause_i, start, end, trend, control, covid) {
    d <- h9_crude_wide %>%
      filter(cause == cause_i, year >= start, year <= end) %>%
      mutate(log_gap = log(Scotland) - log(if (control == "England") England else `Eng: NE+NW`),
             year_c = year - 2018,
             mup = case_when(year < 2018 ~ 0, year == 2018 ~ 8 / 12, TRUE ~ 1),
             post_slope = pmax(0, year - 2018),
             covid_term = if_else(year %in% 2020:2021, 1, 0))
    if (covid == "exclude") d <- filter(d, !year %in% 2020:2021)
    if (any(!is.finite(d$log_gap))) return(tibble(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, dropped = TRUE))
    m <- if (trend == "full" & covid == "indicator") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid_term, data = d) else
      if (trend == "full" & covid == "exclude") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup, data = d) else
        if (trend == "pre-only" & covid == "indicator") lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope + covid_term, data = d) else
          lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + post_slope, data = d)
    if (any(is.na(coef(m))) || df.residual(m) < 1) {
      return(tibble(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, dropped = TRUE))
    }
    v <- NeweyWest(m, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)
    L <- setNames(rep(0, length(coef(m))), names(coef(m)))
    L["mup"] <- 1
    if (trend == "pre-only") L["post_slope"] <- mean(2019:end - 2018)
    tibble(estimate = sum(L * coef(m)), se = sqrt(as.numeric(t(L) %*% v %*% L)), df = df.residual(m), dropped = FALSE)
  })) %>%
  unnest(fit) %>%
  mutate(p = 2 * pt(-abs(estimate / se), df),
         effect_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
         lcl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate - qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         ucl_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate + qt(0.975, df) * se) - 1),
         wyper = start == 2012 & end == 2020 & control == "England" & trend == "full")
print(count(h9_multiverse, cause, dropped))

h9_multiverse_summary <- bind_rows(
  h9_multiverse %>% filter(!dropped) %>% mutate(dimension = "overall", level = "all"),
  h9_multiverse %>% filter(!dropped) %>%
    mutate(across(c(start, end), as.character)) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(start, end, trend, control, covid), names_to = "dimension", values_to = "level")
) %>%
  group_by(cause, dimension, level) %>%
  summarise(n_specs = n(),
            median_pct = median(effect_pct),
            q25_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.25),
            q75_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.75),
            pct_negative = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0),
            pct_negative_p05 = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0 & p < 0.05),
            .groups = "drop")
print(filter(h9_multiverse_summary, dimension == "overall"))

# POST-HOC (FLAG): start >= 2011 only, after the 2011 ICD-10 coding change (F10.0 -> X45)
h9_multiverse_summary_2011 <- h9_multiverse %>%
  filter(!dropped, start >= 2011) %>%

            q75_pct = quantile(effect_pct, 0.75),
            pct_negative = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0),
            pct_negative_p05 = 100 * mean(effect_pct < 0 & p < 0.05),
            .groups = "drop")
print(h9_multiverse_summary_2011)
print(h9_multiverse_summary, n = 80)

# EXPLORATORY (not pre-specified): ESP2013 ASMR, Scotland 2022 missing, primary 2012-2024 model
h9_asmr <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "cause_asmr") %>%

h9_model_k70_asmr <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h9_asmr, cause == "k70"))
h9_vcov_k70_asmr <- NeweyWest(h9_model_k70_asmr, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)

print(coefci(h9_model_k70_asmr, vcov = h9_vcov_k70_asmr, df = df.residual(h9_model_k70_asmr))["mup", ])

h9_model_f10_asmr <- lm(log_gap ~ year_c + mup + covid, data = filter(h9_asmr, cause == "f10"))
h9_vcov_f10_asmr <- NeweyWest(h9_model_f10_asmr, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE)

h9_asmr_table <- tibble(

          coefci(h9_model_f10_asmr, vcov = h9_vcov_f10_asmr, df = df.residual(h9_model_f10_asmr))["mup", 2],

print(h9_asmr_table)
```
